department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: International Fall 2027 application deadline is May 1, 2027 (document submissions due June 1).

also.quote: International Application Deadlines | Fall | Application | Document Submissions | May 1 | June 1

gre_general.value: GRE General Test required (Quantitative >= 150, Verbal >= 147, Analytical Writing >= 3.5); waived only for Tennessee Tech B.S. alumni in related fields.
gre_general.quote: GRE® General Test (GRE) scores with Quantitative greater than or equal to 150 (50%); Verbal greater than or equal to 147 (33%); Analytical Writing greater than or equal to 3.5 (33%). Students with BS degrees in related fields from Tennessee Tech are not required to take the GRE.

toefl_min.value: International applicants must score at least 4.0 on the new TOEFL scale (79 iBT on the prior scale).
toefl_min.quote: International students must score at least 4.0 on the TOEFL or a minimum base score of 6.0 on the IELTS.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Civil and Environmental Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-admission supervisor confirmation is not required prior to applying, though availability of appropriate faculty to supervise research is evaluated during admission.

funding.value: Limited Graduate Assistantships provide in-state tuition remission, cover most fees, and pay a monthly stipend (10 hr/week at 50% or 20 hr/week at 100%).
funding.quote: A limited number of Graduate Assistantships are available throughout the University. Graduate Assistantships provide tuition remission at an in-state rate, covers the costs of the majority of your fees, and provides a modest monthly stipend.

entry_route.value: General requirement is a master's degree in an appropriate discipline (MS GPA >= 3.5), with direct admission from a bachelor's degree possible on an exceptional basis.
entry_route.quote: Though the general requirement for admission to the Ph.D. program is a master's degree in an appropriate discipline, students with a bachelor's degree may be admitted to the Ph.D. program directly on exceptional basis

notes: Concentration within the College of Engineering Ph.D. in Engineering (ENGR-DCE). General CoE doctoral admission and degree policies apply.
name: Engineering, Civil Engineering Concentration, Ph.D.
